title: FRB Studio View Definition Schema v0.9 - Section Groups / Markdown Export Mode / Context / Chat Input Mapping / Related Grid View
description: Schema for FRBStudio_App / No-Code JSON Studio view_def JSON files. Includes inheritance, common field types, Markdown export / AI Prompt, dataSources, virtualData registry builders, single-source writeBack, Relation status filters, and toolbar.executeButton action declarations. v0.9 adds chat edit.input.appendPosition/appendLabel and chat Markdown inline link/image permissions. v0.15.5でViewDef context.read_contract定義を追加。 v0.15.5.1で主文脈 Data root main_context_refs[] と対象文脈 Data明細 context_refs[] の正本モデルを追加し、ViewDefは context.main_context.data_path / context.target_context で場所と表示方法だけを宣言する形へ整理。 v0.15.5.3 adds target context Detail-top panel declaration. v0.18.6 adds Markdown Export Mode / ExportDef options: markdown.defaultMode, markdown.modes[], full_dump/review_report/document_sections, fieldPolicy, and field/section markdown.export. v0.18.14 adds FieldGroupType declarations, fieldGroupSources, and dynamic visibleWhen support. v0.18.20 adds field.grid.aggregate for numeric Grid sum rows with filtered/all scope. v0.18.28 adds toolbar.relatedGridViews / related_grid_views for ViewDef-driven Root array launch in a grid_only child Studio. v0.18.34 adds relatedGridViews.viewId / view_id so a related Root Grid can open a named views[] entry from the same ViewDef file; viewDef remains supported for external files. v0.18.38 adds date as an explicit Field type separate from datetime; date means YYYY-MM-DD only, while datetime means values with a time component. Existing datetime ViewDefs remain valid for compatibility. v0.18.52 adds section.fieldSets as a Detail layout contract that groups existing fields in a full-width three-column FieldSet; caption is optional and empty caption renders border-only grouping. v0.18.64 adds standard search override shape (operator/operator_set/operators); SearchOperatorRegistry is the vocabulary source of truth. v0.18.72 adds optional views[].sectionGroups as a declarative grouping contract that references existing sections by sectionIds without duplicating Section definitions; grouping is one level only in this phase. v0.18.124 adds field.grid.action for ViewDef-declared per-cell actions such as opening a managed Data JSON in another Studio window without introducing a domain-specific Field type. v0.18.125 adds field.search.initialValue / applyOnLoad so a ViewDef can declare the initial search control value separately from field.defaultValue and optionally apply that filter immediately after Data load. v0.18.133 adds Field.width FULL mode: explicit full-row width in Header/Detail and remaining-width Grid columns while Search remains fixed at Studio standard width.

item_definition_ref.description: Optional relative path under the independent fielddefs root. The ViewDef references one sparse Field Definition set. Omit it for legacy ViewDefs and resolve all fields implicitly from ViewDef type behavior.

extends.description: ViewDef inheritance. String or array of parent view_def JSON file names.

sectionGroups.description: Optional display grouping of existing sections. Groups are navigation/projection metadata inside the view; section definitions remain canonical in sections[].

sectionGroup.description: One display group inside a View. It selects existing sections by ID. It does not define or duplicate Sections and is intentionally one-level in v0.18.72.

id.description: Unique group ID within the containing view. Cross-item uniqueness is verified by the ViewDef contract/static validator.

caption.description: Human-readable label for the group navigation.

sectionIds.description: IDs of existing sections in the same view. The same Section may be referenced by multiple groups; ungrouped Sections are allowed.

editorComponents.description: 標準Detail EditorへHost / Registry経由で接続するEditor Component宣言。

fieldSets.description: Detail Editor内で既存fieldsを意味的なまとまりとして囲むFieldSet宣言。Field定義はsection.fieldsを正本とし、FieldSetはfield名参照だけを持つ。Runtimeでは常に3列フル幅で新しい行の左端から開始し、終了後も次行へ送る。

field_sets.description: fieldSetsのsnake_case互換名。新規ViewDefではfieldSetsを優先する。

initial_sort.description: initialSortのsnake_case互換名。新規ViewDefではinitialSortを優先する。

width.description: Field共通の視覚幅。数値はpx幅、`FULL` はHeader / Basic Info / Detailで利用可能行幅いっぱい、Gridでは固定列以外の残り幅を使う可変列として扱う。未指定はStudio標準幅。Searchは操作UIのため本値を参照せずStudio標準幅を使う。Live View Designで保存された数値幅の正本。

layout.description: Detail Dialog内の配置制御。例: {"placement":"detailFooter"} で子配列表示後に描画する。

enumRef.description: Reference to common enum registry, for example context.read_timing.

fieldGroup.description: FieldGroupType expansion options. Resolver expands it before normal Renderer consumes fields.

visibleWhen.description: Row-level visibility condition generated/used by FieldGroupType dynamic switching. Example: {"field":"expected_def_type","equals":"RuleExpectedDef"}.

fieldType.description: dateはYYYY-MM-DDの日付のみ、datetimeは時刻を含む日時を表す。既存datetime資産は互換維持し、新規・改定ViewDefから意味に応じて分離する。

width.description: Legacy Grid-only width. v0.18.132以降の新規幅保存はField.widthを正本とし、既存ViewDef互換の読取のみ維持する。

gridAggregateOptions.description: type=numberのFieldで、Gridヘッダー内に表示時派生集計を描画する宣言。集計値はData保存・CSV Data行へ混入させない。

label.description: 集計の意味を表すラベル。通常Gridの視覚表示は省スペースなΣを使い、このlabelはTooltip・aria-label等の意味補足に利用する。

messages.description: Field type chat用。複数フィールドを会話タイムラインとして表示するためのメッセージ定義。

embeddedFields.description: chat吹き出し内に埋め込む入力フィールド。承認ラジオ等に利用する。

embedded_fields.description: chat吹き出し内に埋め込む入力フィールド。承認ラジオ等に利用する。

markdown.description: このchatメッセージ本文のMarkdownリンク/画像表示許可。

layout.description: Fieldのedit表示における配置制御。field.layout と同じ意味で利用可能。

input.description: Field type chat用のコメント追加入力バー設定。

appendPosition.description: afterMessagesの場合、input.userFieldの本文をmessages定義順ではなく会話末尾に表示する。

append_position.description: afterMessagesの場合、input.userFieldの本文をmessages定義順ではなく会話末尾に表示する。

markdown.description: 送信欄由来のuserField本文に対するMarkdownリンク/画像表示許可。

operator.description: 標準Operatorから明示Overrideする場合のOperator ID。data/json/config/search_operator_registry_v0_1.json のactive operatorsに存在すること。

operator_set.description: 型/Validation Typeから導出される標準Operator Setを置き換える場合のSet ID。SearchOperatorRegistryのactive operator_setsに存在すること。

operators.description: 利用可能Operatorを標準Setから絞り込む特殊Override。各IDはSearchOperatorRegistryのactive operatorsに存在し、型互換であること。

initialValue.description: 検索UIの初期表示値。Field defaultValue（新規Data生成値）とは別責務。単一値Operator向けの初期値として扱う。

applyOnLoad.description: trueの場合、検索UI描画後にinitialValue等の初期検索状態を適用して自動検索する。false/省略時は初期値を表示するだけで自動検索しない。

searchOptions.description: Field検索Projection。visibleで検索UI投影を宣言し、operator/operator_set/operatorsはSearchOperatorRegistry登録語彙だけを使用する。initialValueは検索UI初期値、applyOnLoad=trueはData読込直後の自動検索を宣言する。Field defaultValueとは別責務。Schemaは形、Registryは語彙を正本とする。

markdownOptions.description: Data JSON export configuration used by Markdown出力→Viewer. v0.18.6 treats Markdown output as selectable Export Modes / Export Profiles.

type.description: MarkdownExportRegistry key. Current registered values: auto, generic_sections, screen_state_expected, screen_state_diff, screen_state_test_patterns.

defaultMode.description: Default markdown.modes[].id used by the Markdown出力 button.

modes.description: Selectable Markdown export modes. Recommended ids: full_dump, review_report, document_rebuild.

export.description: When false, review_report mode excludes this markdown section. full_dump ignores it; document_rebuild uses explicit mode fields.
When false, review_report mode excludes this field. full_dump ignores it; document_rebuild uses explicit mode fields.

viewDefReportOptions.description: Future options for ViewDef Markdown→Viewer report. Separate from markdown.type.

builder.description: VirtualDataBuilderRegistry key. Registered examples: relation_axis_cards, relation_diff_cards, relation_diff_check_cards, constraint_trace_cards, test_pattern_trace_cards, expected_check_cross_counts, expected_check_shortage_findings.

statusFilter.description: Evidence relation statuses to include, e.g. ["approved"].

status_filter.description: Evidence relation statuses to include, snake_case alias.

structureStatusFilter.description: Structure relation statuses to include for contains_check etc, e.g. ["derived","approved"].

structure_status_filter.description: Structure relation statuses to include, snake_case alias.

excludeStatus.description: Relation statuses to always exclude, e.g. ["rejected"].

exclude_status.description: Relation statuses to always exclude, snake_case alias.

virtualDataWriteBack.description: virtualDataで生成された仮想行から、主たる更新対象JSON 1つへ一部フィールドを書き戻すための定義。

fields.description: 書き戻し対象フィールド。同名配列、from/to配列、または {仮想field: 元field} のmap。

oneOf.description: Select/radio option object. Default value field is cd; default label field is name. value/id/key and label/caption/text are also supported by runtime.

layoutOptions.description: View/layout options. Runtime currently uses detailDialog: wide for wide detail dialog. String layout header-search-grid-detail is still valid.

executeButtonOptions.description: View-specific primary execute action. Runtime reads action/actionId/action_id as actionId and passes it to ActionRegistry. Do not hard-code Action names in Runtime.

toolbarButtonOptions.description: Reserved for future secondary toolbar buttons. v0.6 runtime only renders executeButton.

toolbarOptions.description: Toolbar declarations. Runtime supports toolbar.executeButton / toolbar.execute_button as the primary View action and toolbar.relatedGridViews / related_grid_views as generic Root-array child Grid launch declarations.

aiPromptOptions.description: Markdown export AI copy block. Attach to grid section markdown.aiPrompt.

markdownInlineOptions.description: chat/textarea内のMarkdownリンク・画像記法の表示許可。保存値はMarkdown原文のまま保持する。

contextRef.description: A context reference item. The same item structure is used by Data root main_context_refs[] and Data target context_refs[]. ViewDef should normally only define how these items are displayed/edited, not embed actual contextRef values.

ref_id.description: Legacy / alias ID for this context reference.

context_ref_id.description: Canonical ID for this context reference.

id.description: Legacy / alias ID for this context reference.

target_path.description: Relative path or target identifier to read.

read_timing.description: Use context.read_timing enum. Example: before_load / before_code_update / before_zip_return.

failure_policy.description: Use context.failure_policy enum. Required refs should normally use stop_and_ask or stop_and_report.

trust.description: Legacy alias for trust_category. Example: canonical / working / reference.

purpose.description: Why this context must be read.

trust_category.description: Use context.trust_category enum. Canonical name; trust is legacy alias.

enabled.description: Whether this context ref is active.

rowContextContract.description: Legacy compatibility contract for row-level context references. Prefer context.target_context for new ViewDefs.

data_path.description: JSONPath-like path to row-level context refs, for example $.context_refs.

readContract.description: Legacy compatibility ViewDef-level AI context read declaration from v0.15.5. For new ViewDefs, do not embed actual required_refs; declare main_context_data_path or context.main_context.data_path and keep actual refs in Data JSON.

required_refs.description: Deprecated for new ViewDefs. Do not embed concrete context ref data in ViewDef; put it in Data JSON and declare the path.

requiredRefs.description: Deprecated for new ViewDefs. Do not embed concrete context ref data in ViewDef; put it in Data JSON and declare the path.

optional_refs.description: Deprecated for new ViewDefs. Do not embed concrete context ref data in ViewDef; put it in Data JSON and declare the path.

preflight_rules.description: Deprecated for new ViewDefs. Do not embed concrete context ref data in ViewDef; put it in Data JSON and declare the path.

main_context_data_path.description: Path to Data root main context refs, e.g. $.main_context_refs.

required_refs_data_path.description: Legacy-compatible alias for a Data path containing required refs.

viewDefContextOptions.description: ViewDef context metadata. ViewDef must declare where context data lives and how it is displayed/edited. Actual Main Context data belongs in Data JSON (for example $.main_context_refs); actual Target Context data belongs in each Data target object (for example context_refs[]). Old context.read_contract is supported only as legacy compatibility.

read_contract.description: Legacy compatibility declaration. Do not embed concrete required_refs in new ViewDefs; point to Data main_context_refs[] instead.

readContract.description: Legacy compatibility declaration. Do not embed concrete required_refs in new ViewDefs; point to Data main_context_refs[] instead.

context_refs.description: Deprecated / legacy only. Do not store actual context ref data in ViewDef for new definitions. Use Data root main_context_refs[] or Data target context_refs[] instead.

main_context.description: Declaration for where Data root Main Context refs live and how to display/edit them. Runtime may render it as a header panel. This is not the place for actual refs data.

mainContext.description: Declaration for where Data root Main Context refs live and how to display/edit them. This is not the place for actual refs data.

mainContextContract.description: Preferred Main Context declaration. ViewDef declares the Data path that contains ViewDef-wide Main Context refs and the Runtime may render it as a header summary/expand panel. Actual context ref items belong in Data JSON, e.g. $.main_context_refs, not inside ViewDef.

display_name.description: Recommended Japanese display name: 主文脈.

refs.description: Deprecated. Do not store actual main context refs in ViewDef for new definitions. Use Data root main_context_refs[] and declare its path with data_path.

required_refs.description: Deprecated legacy alias. Do not store actual refs in ViewDef; use Data root main_context_refs[].

data_path.description: JSONPath-like path to Data root Main Context refs. Example: $.main_context_refs.

id_field.description: ID field name for a context ref item.

title_field.description: Title field name for a context ref item.

target_path_field.description: Target path field name for a context ref item.

read_timing_field.description: Read timing field name for a context ref item.

failure_policy_field.description: Failure policy field name for a context ref item.

trust_category_field.description: Trust category field name for a context ref item.

purpose_field.description: Purpose field name for a context ref item.

header_panel.description: Optional display hint for Runtime header panel. The actual refs still live in Data JSON.

display_mode.description: Recommended value for v0.15.5.2: header_panel. Do not create a normal main Grid only for Main Context.

targetContextContract.description: How this ViewDef identifies target-level context refs in Data JSON. Target context belongs to each Data target row, for example an incident, test pattern, rule, or constraint item. Runtime may render it as a Detail-top summary/expand/edit panel and grid cells should prefer a count summary instead of raw JSON.

display_name.description: Recommended Japanese display name: 対象文脈.

field.description: Canonical Data field name for target context refs. Default: context_refs.

data_path.description: JSONPath-like path relative to a target row. Example: $.context_refs.

grid_summary.description: When true, grid cells should display a compact target context count summary instead of raw objectArray JSON.

detail_panel.description: Target Context Detail-top panel declaration. Actual context ref items remain in Data row context_refs[].

currentDataDisplay.description: 現在読み込み中Dataの人間向けタイトル表示設定。Dataパスは住所、タイトルは看板として扱う。

titlePath.description: Data JSONから現在Dataタイトルとして表示する値のJSON path。例: $.title

subtitlePath.description: Data JSONから補助タイトルとして表示する値のJSON path。例: $.target

titleFallbackPaths.description: titlePathで値が取れない場合のfallback候補。例: ["$.name", "$.document_title"]

showDataPath.description: 読み込み元Dataパスを住所として表示するか。原則true。

markdownModeOptions.description: One selectable Markdown Export Mode / Export Profile. Main control is mode-based, not field-based.

source.description: JSON path or symbolic row source. Example: $.rules, rows, currentRows.

markdownFieldControlOptions.description: Field-level Markdown behavior for normal ViewDef fields. Used mainly by review_report mode; full_dump ignores it and document_rebuild uses explicit mode fields.

export.description: When false, review_report mode excludes the field.

relatedGridViewOptions.description: Generic declaration for opening one Data-root array in a modal or separate Studio child view. Use viewId/view_id to open a named views[] entry from the current ViewDef file, viewDef/view_def/view to load an external ViewDef file, or both to select a named view inside an external file. Runtime must not hard-code domain field names.

viewId.description: Named views[].id to open. When viewDef is omitted, resolve from the current ViewDef file.

type.description: EditorComponentRegistry に登録された Component type。

id.description: 同一Editor内でComponentを識別する任意ID。

placement.description: 標準Detail Editor内のComponent配置位置。

config.description: Component固有の宣言的UI設定。計算・判定・導出アルゴリズムは記述しない。

fieldSet.description: Detail EditorのFieldSet。既存Fieldを参照して枠でグルーピングするレイアウト契約。横幅や開始列は指定せず、Runtime標準として常に3列フル幅・行左端開始とする。captionは任意で、空文字または省略時は空legendを描画せず枠だけ表示する。

fields.description: section.fields[].field を参照する。Field定義そのものをFieldSet内へ複製しない。

gridInitialSort.description: Grid初期表示時の1列ソート。ユーザーが列見出しを操作した後は通常のsortStateを優先する。

gridFieldActionOptions.description: Optional per-cell Action declaration. Runtime reads action/actionId/action_id and dispatches it through ActionRegistry. sourceField selects the row value passed as actionValue. This is behavior, not a Field data type.
